prompt: How many active players have won one or more ATP Finals singles titles? Please note that Andy Murray is no longer active.
answer: 6 active players have won one or more ATP Finals singles titles: Novak Djokovic, Jannik Sinner, Alexander Zverev, Grigor Dimitrov, Daniil Medvedev, and Stefanos Tsitsipas. Andy Murray is excluded because he retired in 2024.
